title: LOC Property Test Vector File
description: A collection of LOC property vectors: one property type and its value, as a transport Key-Value-Pair delivers them, paired with what the value means under one LOC draft or the complaint it must draw. Vectors are independent of transport framing: an even type's value is the integer the varint carried, an odd type's value is its bytes.

topic.description: What the file exercises, and its file name without the extension: a property ('timestamp', 'video-frame-marking') or 'conflicts' for types the draft gives more than one meaning.

spec_section.description: The section of the draft most of the file's vectors cite. Each vector's description cites its own.

fields.description: Semantic fields of one reading of a value. Integers are strings of decimal digits.

timestamp.description: Timestamp or Capture Timestamp, in the units the draft gives it.

length.description: Video Config or Audio Config: the number of bytes. The drafts give these bytes no structure of their own; they are the codec's configuration, passed on as they are.

octets.description: Video Frame Marking: which RFC 9626 3.1 form the reading is, 1, 2 or 3 octets. A 1-octet reading covers the short form of 3.2 as well, which is the same octet with B and TID zero.

LID.description: Layer ID, 8 bits; present in the 2- and 3-octet forms.

TL0PICIDX.description: Temporal Layer 0 Picture Index, 8 bits; present in the 3-octet form.

voice_activity.description: Audio Level: the V bit of RFC 6464 Section 3.

level.description: Audio Level: 0 to 127, meaning 0 to -127 dBov (RFC 6464 Section 3).

decoded.description: What the value means. Exactly one of four shapes. A reading: `name` and the semantic fields. Candidates: `name` and `candidates`, two or more complete readings, when the draft leaves the form of the value open; a decoder reports them all and picks none. Uninterpreted: `name` and `uninterpreted: true`, when the draft admits the value but defines no reading for it; a decoder shows it raw. Ambiguous: `ambiguous` alone, listing the meanings the draft gives the property type; a decoder shows the value raw with those names.

id.description: Unique identifier within the file. Kebab-case.

description.description: What the vector asserts, and the section of the draft (and of RFC 9626 or RFC 6464) that decides it.

value.description: Even types: the integer the varint carried, in decimal.

value_hex.description: Odd types: the value bytes, lowercase hex, possibly empty.

error.description: Error category for invalid vectors. invalid_length: an odd type's value has a length outside the range the draft states. out_of_range: an even type's value is outside the values the draft states, or needs more bytes than the draft allows it.

error_detail.description: Optional human-readable detail: usually the line of the draft the value breaks.
